description: NHFLOW 2D wave tank, linear waves (B 92 2, H 0.5 m, T 4.5 s, h 4 m) from a relaxation zone (B 98 2) with the start-up ramp B 101 1 over two periods (B 102 2); beach B 99 1. The ramp acts on the wave only: before hans_dev fe03b66a it also scaled the still water depth of the zone (WL target 0 at t = 0, umax 5 m/s in this case).
